mapper.select: SELECT r.PICK_RSLT_NO, r.PICK_LIST_NO, r.ALLOC_NO, r.PICK_QTY, a.ITEM_CD, a.LOC_CD, a.ALLOC_QTY, i.ITEM_NM FROM PICK_RSLT r JOIN SHIP_ALLOC a ON r.ALLOC_NO = a.ALLOC_NO JOIN ITEM_MST i ON a.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD WHERE r.PICK_LIST_NO = #{pickListNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PICK_RSLT (PICK_RSLT_NO, PICK_LIST_NO, ALLOC_NO, PICK_QTY) VALUES (#{pickRsltNo}, #{pickListNo}, #{allocNo}, #{pickQty})
